{{Quote|There are eighteen ships&mdash;make that nineteen, now&mdash;in this outbound corridor. In theory they're all heading for the Foless Crossroads, or for Darepp.''"<br />"''In theory?''"<br />"''Under free-navigation rules, they don't have to file flight plans and announce their destinations&mdash;they just have to announce themselves as they leave here and when they get there.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]|<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
The '''Foless Crossroads''' was the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="FaDCR" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Foless/Legends|Foless]] sat at this intersection,<ref name="FaDCR" /> in the [[Southern Core]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The planet [[Darepp]] was located near the Foless Crossroads.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|284|Foless Crossroads}}</ref>
